summary: Revalidated PKUCity public login at 390x844, regression testIDs, console state, overflow, API health, and unauthenticated protection.
action_items: Provide a real approved Google test identity or session token before claiming authenticated-flow coverage.
Replace the fixed client-supplied blink-and-smile liveness signal with production-grade anti-spoof verification before production use.
critical_code_review_comments: Authenticated OAuth, camera, location, attendance acceptance/rejection, admin, profile, and bottom navigation flows remain unverified because no Google test identity or session token is available.
The current liveness implementation is a guided capture heuristic: the client always submits the literal blink-and-smile value after any photo, so it is not actual face/liveness detection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview https://face-check-attend-2.preview.emergentagent.com. Login rendered at 390x844; document and body widths matched viewport; no console errors. GET /api/ returned 200; GET /api/auth/me and valid POST /api/attendance without Bearer returned 401. No auth credentials are recorded in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
rca_of_issue: Prior iteration's decorative-orb overflow is resolved by authRoot overflow clipping. No new defects reproduced. Authenticated coverage is blocked by unavailable external Google credentials, not by a reproduced app failure.
